findings.highlight: Shirou...if you're going to do this, you need to win even if it kills you. I will never, ever forgive you if I wake up and find you dead and defeated."
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎。やるからには死んでも勝ちなさい。わたしが起きた時、アンタがくたばってたら許さないから」
findings.governingReading: She commands victory even at the cost of death, immediately contradicting that bravado by threatening not to forgive him if he is dead when she wakes.
findings.explanation: Rin forbids dying; English restricts the prohibition to dying defeated.

findings.highlight: And so Tohsaka drifts right off to sleep.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂はもうごうごうと、遠慮も容赦もなく寝入ってしまった。
findings.governingReading: ごうごう and the paired unrestrained modifiers make the abrupt sleep noisy and comically uninhibited.
findings.explanation: The noisy, unrestrained sleep is reduced to drifting off.

findings.highlight: I nod at Tohsaka's sleeping form.
findings.evidenceJa: 眠りに入った遠坂に声をかける。
findings.governingReading: He directs the preceding reassurance aloud toward Rin after she falls asleep.
findings.explanation: Speaking to the sleeping Rin becomes nodding at her.
